scope: P3-10 synthetic CPL3 broker/provider; no real privileged services
encoding: exactly 160 bytes; twenty little-endian u64 words; no native layout
response: 160 bytes: request_id, status, value, current_epoch, current_revision; remaining words zero
trust: actor and probe routing belong only to the trusted fixture controller; policy caller is always kernel IPC metadata, never actor/principal/session/owner/role payload claims
forwarding: exact single-use ticket plus both current caller and forwarding-service grants; full process-generation/session and epoch binding
invalidation: epoch change clears every assignment/ticket including descendants; session invalidation cannot be undone within incarnation
restart: fresh trusted bootstrap process/session/epoch; empty policy until exact administrator restores and issues fresh assignments; checkpoints confer no authority
